subject.title: fix(reef): add timeout and bounded JSON reads to relay transport

question: Should all Reef relay REST requests unconditionally fail after 15 seconds before response headers, including requests to custom or self-hosted relays?
rationale: Source and proof establish that a bound is needed, but neither current docs nor tests establish 15 seconds as the supported latency contract for every configurable Reef relay.

options.title: Confirm the 15-second deadline
options.body: A Reef owner confirms that 15 seconds is acceptable for hosted and supported self-hosted relay deployments, after which the branch can be refreshed and merged.

options.title: Use the 30-second transport budget
options.body: Raise the REST deadline to match the existing Reef WebSocket handshake budget and update proof to cover a healthy response that completes after 15 seconds.

recommendation.title: Confirm the 15-second deadline
recommendation.body: A Reef owner confirms that 15 seconds is acceptable for hosted and supported self-hosted relay deployments, after which the branch can be refreshed and merged.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed and proved the same Reef relay request boundary on current main.
